source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the short-hand if-else (PDF 42).

blocks.text: Python mein if-else ko chhota kar ke ek hi line mein bhi likha ja sakta hai. Isay short hand if-else kehte hain.

#          Syntax of short hand if-else statement
action_if_true if condition else action_if_false

temperature = 15
print("It’s a hot day") if temperature > 30 else print("It’s not a hot day")

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab short hand statement ko teen lines mein tor kar chhapti hai; aise SyntaxError aata hai. Short hand if-else poori ek line mein likha jata hai, jaise oopar hai.

Wazahat: yeh pichhle topic wali misaal hi hai, bas chhoti shakal mein. Output variable temperature ki value par munhasir hai: 30 se zyada ho to "It's a hot day", warna "It's not a hot day". Yahan 15 hai, to "It's not a hot day" aata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ek if-else statement aur ek short hand if-else statement likhein jo check kare ke number even (juft) hai ya odd (taaq), aur munasib paighaam print kare.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: short hand if-else se even/odd kaise likhenge?
blocks.explanation: num = 7; print("Even") if num % 2 == 0 else print("Odd"). 7 % 2 = 1 hai, to "Odd" print hota hai. Aam if-else wala jawab pichhle topic (2.4.1.2) ke self-check mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Short-hand if-else aam if-else se kaise mukhtalif hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh poora intikhab ek line mein rakhta aur har soorat ke liye ek qeemat ya amal deta hai, jo saade intikhab ke liye munasib hai; aam if-else alag indent wale blocks istemal karta aur har shaakh mein kai statements rakh sakta hai.

items: Short hand: kaam_agar_sach if shart else kaam_agar_jhoot, sab ek line mein.
